title: Grateful Dead Live at Santa Fe Downs on 1982-10-17
lineage: CD (Tascam SS-CDR200) > Tascam DA-3000 (16-bit/44.1k) > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC/16
source: (FOB) AUD > Cassette Master > Cassette > DAT > CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of an outstanding first set and strong second set, highlighted by GDTRFB, The Wheel and a Jerry ballad.
ai_review.review: This upgraded audience tape delivers crystal‑clear sound that finally lets the show shine. Reviewers praise an outstanding first set and a long, well‑played second set (aside from a weaker Brent tune), noting the rare combination of GDTRFB, The Wheel and a heartfelt Jerry ballad. Overall the performance is high‑energy and the new source makes it a serious contender for year‑end lists.

ai_rating.rationale: The single detailed review is overwhelmingly positive about both the musical performance and the upgraded recording quality, warranting a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Significant upgrade from a previously good‑quality audience tape; no soundboard exists. Review notes crisp, clear audio that finally does the show justice.

standout_songs: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad (GDTRFB)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Outstanding first set followed by a long, well‑played second set; the Brent tune is considered a low point and can be skipped.
